keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Hakan Çalhanoglu (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Feyenoord 0, Inter Milan 1. Yann Bisseck (Inter Milan) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Djed Spence.
Goal! Feyenoord 0, Inter Milan 2. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) header from very close range to the top left corner following a fast break.
Manuel Akanji (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card.
Gjivai Zechiël (Feyenoord) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Tobias van den Elshout replaces Charles Vanhoutte.
Second Half begins Feyenoord 0, Inter Milan 2.
Goal! Feyenoord 0, Inter Milan 3. Piotr Zielinski (Inter Milan) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nicolò Barella.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Ange-Yoan Bonny replaces Marcus Thuram.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Henrikh Mkhitaryan replaces Hakan Çalhanoglu.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Sem Steijn replaces Nacho Ferri.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Tsuyoshi Watanabe replaces Javi López.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Jerayno Schaken replaces Givairo Read.
Delay in match (Feyenoord).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Petar Sucic replaces Nicolò Barella.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Aleksandar Stankovic replaces Piotr Zielinski.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Mats Deijl replaces Thijs Kraaijeveld.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Benjamin Pavard replaces Manuel Akanji.
Second Half ends, Feyenoord 0, Inter Milan 3.
